title: ID0431475-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S2 170003305] LEM not functional on DC1
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
LEM not functional on DC1, the LEM 10.20.17.2 is not present on
the internal charger network:
2025-06-16T11:24:59.203957+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp
[local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/192756be2d57[638]: FetchError:
request to http://10.20.17.20/v1/status failed, reason: connect
EHOSTUNREACH 10.20.17.20:80, attempt #4
The LEM IP has been deleted on the outlet configuration menu on
SCB to enable the DC outlet
Solution:
N/A
yyyy-mm-dd:
2025-06-16
